figures.alt: Photo of a mother deer and her spotted fawn standing among ferns in a forest.
figures.caption: A fawn looks like its mother, but it has spots she does not have.

figures.alt: Close photo of a spiky burr stuck to a gray wool sock, with its tiny hooks caught in the knit.
figures.caption: A burr has tiny hooks that grab fabric. People copied that idea to make hook-and-loop fasteners.

figures.alt: Photo of a mother duck walking at a pond edge followed by four ducklings in a line.
figures.caption: Some animal parents guide their young. The ducklings follow their mother.
